source_semantics.control: AI Center Session suggestions exposes Clear history and binds it to ClearHistoryClicked, which delegates only to ClearHistory().
source_semantics.local_transition: Successful structured suggestions are retained only in the component-local _history list, capped at ten entries. ClearHistory executes _history.Clear() and does not reset the current composer, suggestion, output, approval display, or any persisted record.
source_semantics.side_effects: Clear history is browser/component-session-local state only and performs no persistence, AI-provider, WordPress, queue, approval mutation, navigation, audit-receipt, or external-success operation.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/ai-center-approval-status-control.tsx hosts the existing guarded AI Center local session surface and binds only the Clear history button to AIMW-AI-746EDAE589.
laravel_adaptation.state: The adaptation keeps an in-memory session-history collection, caps supplied session entries at the source-equivalent ten-item bound, renders the source-equivalent empty state, disables Clear history while empty, and clears only that collection.
laravel_adaptation.preservation: Clearing history deliberately leaves prompt-key/current-content composer state and currently displayed approval state unchanged, matching the source separation between ClearHistory() and Clear().
laravel_adaptation.network_boundary: The Clear history click calls only setHistory([]). It sends no request, carries no tenant/site/provider/approval/resource identifier, and has no server mutation action contract.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The control is rendered only inside the existing AI Center host when FrontendContext includes ai.use; otherwise the component fails closed.

tenant_isolation.render_boundary: The AI Center host is reached through the authenticated tenant shell and authoritative /tenants/{tenant}/context contract.
tenant_isolation.cross_tenant_boundary: Focused Laravel acceptance proves an Alpha-only authenticated member receives 404 for Beta AI Center/context routes.
tenant_isolation.id_surface: The local history clear accepts no tenant, approval, site, content, provider, or other caller-supplied resource identifier and creates no direct-ID/IDOR surface.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING identity, AI domain, visible-control kind, source file, route, ClearHistoryClicked marker, non-mutation flag, and tenant ownership

history collection is in-memory only, capped at ten entries, and empty state disables the control
